mapper.sql: id, order_no, owner_id, owner_name, phone, house_id, house_no, title, content, repair_type, urgency, status, handler, handler_phone, assign_time, finish_time, cost, rating, feedback, remark, create_time

where.if: AND (order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR house_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR handler LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_order (order_no, owner_id, owner_name, phone, house_id, house_no, title, content, repair_type, urgency, status, handler, handler_phone, assign_time, finish_time, cost, rating, feedback, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{phone}, #{houseId}, #{houseNo}, #{title}, #{content}, IFNULL(#{repairType}, 'OTHER'), IFNULL(#{urgency}, 'NORMAL'), IFNULL(#{status}, 'PENDING'), #{handler}, #{handlerPhone}, #{assignTime}, #{finishTime}, IFNULL(#{cost}, 0), #{rating}, #{feedback}, #{remark}, IFNULL(#{createTime}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM repair_order GROUP BY status
SELECT repair_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM repair_order GROUP BY repair_type ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(rating), 2), 0) FROM repair_order WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
